# Pipe table model and authored positions

```````````````````````````````` example
└── Table scope=1:1..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[left,center,right,none] children=2
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
│   │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="h" children=0
│   └── TableBody children=2
│       ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │   └── TableCell scope=3:2..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       │       └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
│       └── TableRow scope=4:1..4:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── TableCell scope=4:1..4:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│               └── Text scope=4:1..4:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal=": cap" children=0
├── Footnote scope=5:1..6:0 anchor=null attributes={} label="n" children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=5:7..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=5:7..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Cite scope=7:1..7:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Citation scope=7:2..7:3 anchor=null attributes={} referent=footnote(label="n") children=0
            ├── CitationPrefix children=0
            └── CitationSuffix children=0
````````````````````````````````

# Table margin: indentation and container prefixes

Block indentation and container prefixes never change a table's geometry or
where it starts. Columns are counted from the container's content with the
physical line's tab stops, alignment is read against each column's own dash
run, and a simple, multiline or grid table and its rows begin at the table's
margin: the indentation all of its lines share. A pipe row begins at its own
first non-space byte.

```````````````````````````````` example
   | a | b |
   | - | - |
   | c | d |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:4..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none,none] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:4..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:5..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:10..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    └── TableBody children=1
        └── TableRow scope=3:4..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
            ├── TableCell scope=3:5..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            │   └── Text scope=3:6..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
            └── TableCell scope=3:9..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=3:10..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
   Table: cap

   | a |
   | - |
   | b |
.
Document scope=1:1..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:4..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:4..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Table: cap" children=0
└── Table scope=3:4..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:4..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:5..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:6..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    └── TableBody children=1
        └── TableRow scope=5:4..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── TableCell scope=5:5..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=5:6..5:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

# A pipe cell keeps its tabs

A pipe cell holds its bytes, a tab included, whether its row heads a table
after a paragraph or after a caption, or is a body row.

```````````````````````````````` example
Table: cap

| `a→b` | c |
| - | - |
| `d→e` | f |
.
Document scope=1:1..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Table: cap" children=0
└── Table scope=3:1..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none,none] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │   └── Code scope=3:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\tb" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:10..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:11..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    └── TableBody children=1
        └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
            ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            │   └── Code scope=5:3..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d\te" children=0
            └── TableCell scope=5:10..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
                └── Text scope=5:11..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="f" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A paragraph a pipe table header refused becomes a setext heading with its inline content.

```````````````````````````````` example
a
|---|---|
===
.
Document scope=1:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Heading scope=1:1..3:3 anchor="a-------" attributes={} level=1 children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:2..2:0 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=2:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="|---|---|" children=0
````````````````````````````````
